result.exact_expression: one bound operation plus final complete typed snapshot admits one equivariant reciprocal cut
result.precision_and_error: exact proof and finite reference replay
result.scope: A single target operation is fixed under preparation symmetries even when all its individual contacts move. A collective reservation with a complete live snapshot can perform one reciprocal cut and preserve all typed vetoes. Delayed root-time vetoes rule out simultaneously safe and immediate dispatch from an incomplete prefix.

counterexamples_and_failures: Equal entries on different blocks, epochs or metrics cannot identify one operation
Incomplete root prefix can conceal a same-root veto
Gate filtering can erase the failing contact
limitations: Native collective grant, finality, directed root certification, and root-veto ordering remain open
